name: Postgres.js
solves: Provides a fast, full-featured PostgreSQL client for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers with tagged-template SQL, transactions, cursors, and notice handling — without an ORM layer.
best_for: PostgreSQL-only apps that want a minimal, very fast SQL client
Edge/Bun/Deno runtimes where classic `pg` is awkward
Teams writing tagged-template SQL with good ergonomics and safety
Services that pair a thin client with Drizzle/Kysely or hand-written SQL
High-throughput APIs sensitive to client overhead
skip_when: You need a multi-dialect ORM or query builder out of the box
You are on MySQL/SQLite/SQL Server rather than Postgres
You want schema-first migrations and a generated client (Prisma)
You prefer node-postgres (`pg`) ecosystem middleware already in your stack
ORM features (identity map, dirty checking) are required
